eyebrow: SQL for Oracle Financials · Chapter Three
subtitle: Lesson 12 · Aggregation and Aging

code:
-- ERROR: WHERE runs before grouping/aggregation exists
SELECT vendor_id, SUM(invoice_amount) AS total_invoiced
FROM ap_invoices_all
WHERE SUM(invoice_amount) > 50000
GROUP BY vendor_id;
caption: At the point WHERE runs, no "per-supplier total" exists yet.

code:
SELECT vendor_id, SUM(invoice_amount) AS total_invoiced
FROM ap_invoices_all
GROUP BY vendor_id
HAVING SUM(invoice_amount) > 50000;
caption: HAVING runs after GROUP BY has produced its one-row-per-group result.

code:
SELECT vendor_id, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count,
       SUM(invoice_amount) AS total_invoiced
FROM ap_invoices_all
WHERE payment_status_flag <> 'Y'
GROUP BY vendor_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3;
caption: WHERE picks which rows count as unpaid; HAVING picks suppliers with 3+ of them.
